concept_uz: Sonlar kvadrat minoralar va ildiz yertoʻlalarini kashf qiladi: 25 kirsa — 5 chiqadi. Qiziquvchan Ikki tushadi-yu, chiqa olmaydi: kvadrati aniq 2 boʻladigan kasr yoʻq. U qafas bilan chiqadi, ismi pasportga sigʻmaydi — 1,41421356… Sonlar oʻqida teshik borligi maʼlum boʻladi.
style_line: Premium 3D animated feature film style, warm golden light, soft shadows, rich colours, vertical 9:16. No text, no captions, no letters or numerals written anywhere, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A round golden ring-shaped king: a smooth, thick, upright gold ring like a donut standing on its edge, with big kind expressive eyes and a small mouth on the front of the ring, thin cartoon arms and legs, a small jewelled crown tilted to the left, holding a long plain wooden staff. He stands in the middle of a vast empty golden plain at sunrise, front view, centred.

Vertical 9:16 wide landscape. A vast empty golden plain under a huge sky, a warm sun low on the right horizon and a pale smiling moon with a gentle old woman's face on the left side of the sky, soft morning light, a faint straight line on the ground running from left to right through the centre. No characters.

Vertical 9:16. The king's long wooden staff lying flat on the golden plain from left to right, with evenly spaced carved notches along it, the middle notch glowing gold. Low camera angle along the staff, morning light, no characters.

Vertical 9:16 full-body character portrait. A tall, thoughtful teal character with a graceful swan-like curved neck and a flat base, gentle sad eyes, standing inside a glass cage whose front edge is shaped like a large tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). Moody evening light on the golden plain, front view, centred.

On this golden plain build a tall tower of stacked golden blocks, and at its foot a cellar door whose frame is shaped like a big tick-mark with a long roof (the square-root sign). A queue of small excited number-characters waits at the door. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.prompt: A character climbs down into the root-shaped cellar door and pops out a moment later smaller, proud and shining; the queue claps. It says in Uzbek with an excited, high young voice: "Yigirma besh kirdi — besh chiqdi!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

A tall thoughtful teal character with a swan-like curved neck steps out of the queue, peers into the dark cellar and says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad young man's voice: "Ichkarida nima bor ekan?" Then it climbs in. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The cellar door slams shut. Banging from inside and a muffled voice says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad young man's voice: "Chiqolmayapman!" Characters outside shout numbers through the keyhole, then shake their heads. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The teal character finally walks out of the cellar slowly — but now a glass cage shaped like the root sign surrounds it and moves with it. It looks down at the cage sadly. The crowd steps back. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

At the palace gate a guard with a long scroll asks, says in Uzbek with a slow, bored palace guard's voice: "Ismingiz?" The caged character answers slowly, says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad young man's voice: "Bir butun, to'rt, bir, to'rt, ikki, bir, uch, besh…" Time-lapse: the sun sets while the guard keeps writing, the scroll piling up on the ground. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bir butun, toʻrt, bir, toʻrt, ikki, bir, uch, besh…

scenes.prompt: Night at the gate; the guard is asleep on the huge pile of scroll. The caged character sighs and says in Uzbek with a calm, soft, slightly sad young man's voice: "Ismim pasportga sig'mayapti." No subtitles, no on-screen text.

The ring-king walks along the glowing staff and suddenly stops: between two notches, exactly under the caged character, there is a tiny dark hole in the line that no notch covers. He gasps and says in Uzbek with a warm, slightly dramatic middle-aged male voice: "O'qda teshik bor ekan!" No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Dusk. The ring-king sadly points his staff toward the horizon; the caged character and a few other caged characters walk away into the dark distance, where they gather in a circle and begin to whisper. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a warm storyteller's male voice: "Davomi — powerty.uz da." No subtitles, no on-screen text.
